name: data-mb-tip does not count as our tooltip
why: A description on a native <th class="treleases"> (ISRC page) reads as jesus2099's: the next render strips MusicBrainz's class and the description (the 9.99.1406 regression).

name: the generic Length description ignores the ⏱ state
why: After ⏱ the column shows milliseconds while the tooltip still says minutes and seconds.

name: the toggle does not refresh the descriptions
why: The text is right after the next full render only, not after the press.

name: the toggle does not refresh release-tracks' Length tooltips
why: release-tracks keeps saying "rounded to the nearest second" while it shows milliseconds.

name: release-tracks' Length tooltip ignores the ⏱ state
why: The text is rebuilt after the press, but always the seconds one.

name: a description tip is not marked
why: _refreshColumnDescriptions() then finds no header to rewrite.

name: release-tracks' own Length tooltip keeps the description marker
why: Belt and braces: the toggle refreshes the descriptions first and release-tracks' own texts last, so the release-tracks text still wins; the marker removal only matters to a later description refresh without the second call. Recorded so the guard is not mistaken for tested.
